surface_verification.detail: Drove the REAL record_review_pass.py CLI as a subprocess against a throwaway project, then asked the REAL F11 verifier what it made of the result. 9 checks, 0 failures: init writes spec as an ordinary reviews key with no gates key and schema_version 1; the pinned five are present; the gate BLOCKS while spec is unanswered; the CLI can close spec; a pre-promotion record still validates.

behaviors.behavior: spec is a first-class review type
a new record carries reviews.spec and no gates key
the on-disk shape satisfies the NEW consumer contract
behaviors.evidence: test_the_new_shape_satisfies_the_new_consumer_contract PASSED - a MIRROR of the TypeScript reader; drift is a stated residual

behaviors.behavior: pending_types reports spec unanswered when absent from both sections
all 65 real on-disk records still validate
behaviors.evidence: test_every_record_on_disk_still_validates PASSED - walks the real corpus, asserts non-empty first

behaviors.behavior: the Stage-1 ordering rule fires for a new-shape record with no gates key
behaviors.evidence: test_it_fires_for_a_new_shape_record_with_no_gates_key PASSED - was RED against the pre-change code

behaviors.behavior: it accepts a new-shape record whose spec is completed
a completed spec still needs evidence
it skips a record that genuinely cannot answer
a legacy gates.spec still satisfies, and still fires, the ordering rule
immutability holds across the section move; the record round-trips unchanged
a reviews row is authoritative over a legacy gates row when both are present
behaviors.evidence: test_a_reviews_row_wins_over_a_legacy_gates_row PASSED - verified by MUTATION: inverting the read order fails exactly this test

behaviors.behavior: a terminal reviews.spec is immutable on the ordinary path
writing the answer drops a still-pending legacy row, never a terminal one
an unanswered spec still blocks at the F11 gate
behaviors.evidence: test_an_unanswered_spec_row_blocks_like_any_other_type PASSED - had gone VACUOUS under the promotion and was repaired

declared_removals.reason: Four lines that origin/main gained after the fork are replaced, not reverted: the assertion `record['gates']['spec']` and its comment 'Stage 1 lives under gates, not reviews - the five reviews keys are a pinned cross-repo contract the webui refuses to read if a sixth appears'. That statement is exactly what this iterate makes false - the webui shipped a reader that renders unknown review types (ce21323e), so spec is now an ordinary reviews key. The test keeps the same subject and asserts the new truth (reviews.spec completed, plus no gates key, since a still-pending legacy row is superseded when the real answer lands). Nobody's work is lost; the claim it encoded was retired by this change.
